capabilities: Encrypt typed secrets into [|vault:id|] placeholders automatically
Store encrypted payloads in a local vault.json outside the notes
Unlock and lock secrets with a master key via command palette
Keep master and vault keys in RAM only, never written to disk
Reveal secrets in Editor (Live Preview) and Reading modes
disambiguation: Not a note- or vault-locking tool; it encrypts individual secret strings inline while the rest of the note stays readable.
extras: No password recovery: losing the Master Key means secrets cannot be decrypted. Secrets only auto-encrypt when the vault is Unlocked; while Locked, [|secret|] stays plain text. Recommends excluding vault.json from sync providers (e.g., .gitignore or Obsidian Sync).
motivation: The author wants secrets decoupled from Markdown text so they stay invisible to LLMs, sync providers like iCloud/Dropbox, and search indexers.
problem: Obsidian notes are plain files that get synced to cloud providers and fed to AI tools, so secrets typed directly in Markdown are exposed to services and indexers.
summary: Secrets manager that encrypts sensitive strings as [|vault:id|] placeholders in Markdown, keeping encrypted payloads in a local vault file.
